title: Why do Indian families get health insurance claims rejected or only partly paid?
summary: Health insurance complaints rose 41% in a year, mostly over refused, delayed or partly paid claims. Here's "ClaimShield", a claim-dispute copilot one person could build with Claude in a weekend.
who: Policyholders and their families who receive a rejection or a short payout after a hospital stay, often with a one-line reason they cannot interpret. Hospital billing desks and small insurance advisors who help them face the same paperwork every week.
facts: **Where this came from:** IRDAI grievance data reported in Indian financial news ([Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/personal-finance/irdai-data-reveals-41-spike-in-health-insurance-grievances-over-claim-settlements-in-fy25), [Coverfox](https://www.coverfox.com/news/irdai-says-insurance-ombudsmen-resolved-41055-grievances-in-fy26/)), coverage of regulator action on claim handling ([Outlook Money](https://www.outlookmoney.com/personal-finance/irdai-flags-major-lapses-in-health-insurance-claims-heres-what-you-can-do-if-your-claim-gets-rejected)), and personal-finance explainers on partial payouts and rejection reasons ([Money9](https://www.money9.com/news/insurance/partial-payment-of-insurance-claims-without-explanation-what-to-do-60310.html), [PrimeInvestor](https://primeinvestor.in/reports/claim-rejection-four-excuses-health-insurers/)), echoing frequent complaints in Indian personal-finance forums.

**Complaints are rising fast.** Health insurance complaints rose 41% to 1,37,361 in FY25, from 97,503 in FY24, according to IRDAI data ([Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/personal-finance/irdai-data-reveals-41-spike-in-health-insurance-grievances-over-claim-settlements-in-fy25)).

**Claims are the core issue.** Nearly 7 in 10 complaints in general and health insurance were linked to claim refusal, settlement delays, partial payments and documentation disputes ([Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/personal-finance/irdai-data-reveals-41-spike-in-health-insurance-grievances-over-claim-settlements-in-fy25)).

**Policyholders usually win when they escalate.** Insurance ombudsmen resolved 41,055 grievances in FY26, and nearly 79% of rulings favoured policyholders ([Coverfox](https://www.coverfox.com/news/irdai-says-insurance-ombudsmen-resolved-41055-grievances-in-fy26/)).

**The regulator has flagged lapses.** IRDAI issued show-cause notices to eight insurers over issues including complex customer information sheets and gaps in claim review committees ([Outlook Money](https://www.outlookmoney.com/personal-finance/irdai-flags-major-lapses-in-health-insurance-claims-heres-what-you-can-do-if-your-claim-gets-rejected)).
players: ClaimBuddy helps patients and hospitals manage claims and says it has processed claims for over 35,000 patients worth more than Rs 500 crore with 250+ partner hospitals ([Indian Startup News](https://indianstartupnews.com/funding/claimbuddy-simplifying-the-health-insurance-claim-process-raises-usd-5m-in-funding-4480790)). Legal-help services and brokers also assist with disputes. Few self-serve tools read the policy wording and the rejection letter together and draft the escalation for the family.
pitch: "ClaimShield" reads your policy and the insurer's rejection or settlement letter, explains each deduction in plain language, checks it against the policy wording, and drafts the grievance and ombudsman complaint.
features: Upload the rejection or settlement letter; it lists each deduction and the reason code in plain English or Hindi.
Matches every deduction to the clause in your policy wording, such as room-rent caps, waiting periods or non-payable items, and flags those that look unsupported.
Writes the grievance to the insurer, then the Bima Bharosa complaint and the ombudsman application, with the right attachments listed.
Tracks response windows for each stage and reminds the family when to escalate.
Before discharge, lists the documents and bill items most likely to cause a dispute.
capabilities: Builds the web app, document parsers, deadline logic, tests and deployment.
Reads scanned letters, hospital bills and policy wordings, matches deductions to clauses, and drafts complaints.
A "health-claim-dispute" skill holds common deduction types, escalation steps and letter templates.
Produces a one-page claim summary the family can share with the hospital or an advisor.
Pulls insurer emails and documents from Gmail or Google Drive.
Checks deadlines daily and sends reminders before each escalation window closes.
plan: Collect ten anonymised rejection or short-payout letters with their policy wordings and list every deduction type.
Use Claude Code to extract deductions from letters and bills into structured data.
Write the clause-matching logic as a Claude skill and test it on your ten cases.
Add the grievance, Bima Bharosa and ombudsman draft generators.
Build the deadline tracker and reminder emails.
Create the shareable one-page claim summary.
Run it with three families or one small insurance advisor and compare with their own reading of the case.
prompt:
Build a Next.js + TypeScript web app called "ClaimShield" for Indian health insurance policyholders.

Flow: the user uploads their policy wording PDF, the insurer's rejection or settlement letter, and the hospital bill -> extract every deduction with amount and stated reason -> call the Claude API to match each deduction to the relevant policy clause and mark it supported, unclear or unsupported, with the clause quoted -> explain the result in plain English or Hindi -> draft a grievance letter to the insurer, and later a Bima Bharosa complaint and an insurance ombudsman application -> track deadlines for each stage and send reminders.

Include: a case dashboard, a one-page shareable summary, sample anonymised documents for tests, and unit tests for the deduction maths. Never give legal guarantees; show a clear disclaimer. Keep all medical data encrypted and private per account.
pricing: Free: decode one letter and see the policy check.
Rs 499 per case for full escalation drafts and deadline tracking.
Rs 2,999 a month for insurance advisors and hospital billing desks handling many cases.
Pricing is a suggestion and has not been validated.
risk: Families may prefer a human expert to handle the dispute and may not trust software with a large medical bill.
test: Offer free reviews of ten real disputed claims through an insurance advisor. If at least four cases show a deduction that looks unsupported and two families file the drafted grievance, the product has a case; if not, sell it to advisors as a back-office tool instead.
caution: This is not legal or insurance advice; say so clearly. Health records are sensitive personal data, so handle them under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act with consent and encryption.
